mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_comment (post_id, user_id, parent_comment_id, content, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{parentCommentId}, #{content}, 'ACTIVE', NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT comment_id, post_id, user_id, parent_comment_id, content, status, created_at, updated_at FROM post_comment WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT comment_id, post_id, user_id, parent_comment_id, content, status, created_at, updated_at FROM post_comment WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY created_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE post_comment SET content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE post_comment SET status = 'DELETED' WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
